Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		bankCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		bankCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		InputCard = bankCard and
		CardIDValidated = true and
		result = true or
		bankCard.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
